layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Buildings)

Building Description: FAIRBANK MEMORIAL PARK - OUTDOOR POOL SERVICE BLDG
KEELESDALE PARK - BASEBALL CLUBHOUSE & CHANGE / WASHROOM
CHARLES CACCIA PARK SEWAGE PUMPING STATION

layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building (EPSG:4326), unfiltered except the buildings excluded above: ones that duplicate named parks already shown by the green-spaces/parks-rec layers (see real-estate-park-buildings below) and ones that are carparks (see real-estate-parking-buildings below). Re-download and replace data/raw/building-asset-inventory.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Parking Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-buildings, filtered down to buildings whose description contains "CARPARK" — grouped under Transportation instead of Governance.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Park Buildings)

Building Description: FAIRBANK MEMORIAL PARK - OUTDOOR POOL SERVICE BLDG
KEELESDALE PARK - BASEBALL CLUBHOUSE & CHANGE / WASHROOM
CHARLES CACCIA PARK SEWAGE PUMPING STATION

layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-buildings, filtered down to buildings that sit within named parks already covered by the green-spaces layer (Fairbank Memorial Park, Keelesdale Park, Bert Robinson Park, Cedarvale Park, Charles Caccia Park) — grouped under Parks & Public Realm instead of Governance so they aren't shown twice under two different categories.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Land)
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land (EPSG:4326), excluding parcels typed "Park/Rec/Open Space" (shown instead by real-estate-park-land below, under Parks & Public Realm), parcels described as a "CARPARK" (shown instead by real-estate-parking-land below, under Transportation), and parcels typed "School" (shown instead by real-estate-school-land below, under Community Services & Institutions). Re-download and replace data/raw/land-asset-inventory.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Park Land)
layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-land, filtered down to parcels typed "Park/Rec/Open Space" — grouped under Parks & Public Realm instead of Governance so they aren't shown twice under two different categories.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (School Land)
layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-land, filtered down to parcels typed "School" — grouped under Community Services & Institutions instead of Governance so they aren't shown twice under two different categories.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Parking Land)
layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-land, filtered down to parcels whose description contains "CARPARK" — grouped under Transportation instead of Governance.

layers.label: Toronto Community Housing
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Toronto Community Housing Data (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/community-housing.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Supportive Housing
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Supportive Housing (already WGS84 per its .prj — no reprojection needed). Source was a shapefile (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj); converted straight to GeoJSON with pyshp. To refresh: re-download the shapefile (all 4 parts) and re-run the same conversion.

layers.label: Places of Worship
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Places of Worship (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/places-of-worship.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Parks & Recreation Facilities
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Parks and Recreation Facilities (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/parks-and-recreation-facilities.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Major Transit Station Areas
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Major Transit Station Area Delineations (Jan 2026). Source was a shapefile in NAD27 MTM Zone 10 (no "-4326" GeoJSON export existed) — converted to EPSG:4326 with pyproj and committed directly as GeoJSON (see conversion notes in README.md). To refresh: re-download the shapefile (all 4 parts: .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj), re-run the same conversion, and replace this file.

layers.label: Long-Term Care Locations (City-Operated)
